Name: Stardrops for the good boys
Author: SqueakGames
Description:
Do you need a best stamina, and is quick jumping the days? So this mod is for you! This mod change all the presents given by the NPCs with Stardrops.
Using the power of CWSG, this mod changes the presents given by ALL NPCs (Vanilla, other compatibilities coming soon) with the magical and marvelous Stardrops!


(I dont use modded NPCs, so, the compatibilities will come soon)
